assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production ground-only terrain patch for an existing Chinese myth isometric action game. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only, not edit targets. Create a new finely crafted flat terrain patch, landscape 3:2 composition, matching the warm ochre charcoal weathered stone/woodcut and restrained pixel-grain of the references. Camera fixed high three-quarter isometric but terrain on one flat battle plane. Broad open weathered stone combat courtyard occupies left-middle (35% width,60% height). A clear continuous ancient stone-paved main route enters at left edge at 50% height and exits right edge at 50% height. Near 72% width the route forks into a much narrower dirt/root-lined side trail exiting the TOP edge at 72% width. Worn stone slabs, small broken tile edges, carved subtle sun-bird motif flush in the floor, scattered tiny ochre leaves, grass seams and ink-dark earth softly define the fork. Crisp readable traversable lanes with quiet uncluttered interiors for small characters and enemy telegraphs; detailed edges, low-contrast center. NO trees, walls, pillars, objects with height, lanterns, altar, text, labels, arrows, characters, UI, borders or perspective horizon. Ground artwork only. Transparent softly irregular outer edge, genuine alpha outside the patch; no baked checkerboard, no opaque rectangular vignette. Reference identity/color/material continuity important. This patch is used in just one local sample courtyard/fork, not a complete level.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE 2-by-2 game prop atlas with genuine transparent alpha, square canvas, for Chinese myth 九鼎 Tanggu fixed isometric game. Images supplied are STYLE references only. Four isolated complete objects centered within FOUR EQUAL SQUARE CELLS with at least 12% transparent padding in each cell, no overlap across cell boundaries. Top-left: a low ancient bronze tripod brazier, warm small amber flame, weathered bronze with engraved sunbird motif, stone foot base. Top-right: a slender ancient stone-and-bronze roadside waystone with subtle sunbird carving, no writing or arrow signage. Bottom-left: a low gnarled burnt fusang root bank with ochre grass and stones, a long shallow horizontal ground-boundary prop. Bottom-right: a low broken masonry stone edging with ochre moss/grass and chipped carved stone, horizontal ground-boundary prop. Fixed high three-quarter isometric camera, same angle on every prop, ground plane level. Woodcut/paper-shadow silhouette detail blended with restrained pixel grain, muted dark ink, bronze, ochre and sandstone, upper-left warm lighting. Fine craft and strong readable silhouettes at small size. NO background gradients, NO brown matte, NO contact shadow outside the object (renderer adds it), NO terrain scene, no characters, no text or numbers or grid lines, no labels, no watermark. Empty canvas must be truly transparent; preserve soft flame alpha. Keep objects entirely inside their own equal cells.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production VFX TEXTURE ATLAS, 4 columns x 2 rows, EIGHT exactly equal square cells, on genuinely transparent alpha. Wide 2:1 canvas. These are isolated VFX texture primitives for a Chinese myth shadow-puppet / woodcut action RPG, not a gameplay screenshot. Each primitive centered in its own cell with large transparent padding (at least 15%), no overlap between cells. Read order left-to-right top-to-bottom: 0 a horizontal narrow gold arrow-energy streak with sharp bright tip pointing RIGHT and delicate grain feathering left; 1 a hand-cut asymmetric gold impact spark star, tiny paper-splinter rays, transparent between rays; 2 an imperfect broken gold circular ground shock ring seen straight-on (renderer will flatten), very thin open center and grainy irregular rim; 3 a charcoal ink-and-ochre dust puff with scattered paper flecks, translucent and airy, no solid blob; 4 a delicate warm amber sunburst charge halo with hollow center and eight subtle cut-paper rays; 5 a small sparse handful of amber ember flecks, transparent between every spark; 6 one long tapered cream-gold feather-like slash pointing RIGHT with finely engraved hatching; 7 three small torn ochre paper/stone leaf flecks, isolated as one tiny cluster. Palette restricted warm gold, ivory highlight, ochre, charcoal. Refined woodcut hatching, restrained pixel grain, readable silhouettes, NOT neon sci-fi, not generic glossy magic. These textures animate through scale/fade and position in engine; do NOT bake motion backgrounds. No letters, captions, numbers, labels, grid borders, characters, weapons, colored background, opaque vignette, checkerboard or sheet title. Real transparent alpha and transparent empty cell centers are mandatory.
